description: This file contains functions for deserializing various remote values in the Playwright project, specifically handling different data types and converting serialized representations into usable JavaScript objects.

methods.name: deserializeBidiValue
methods.description: Deserializes a remote value based on its type, converting it into a corresponding JavaScript value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes a value in the internal ID map, or returns a default value.

methods.name: deserializeBidiList
methods.description: Deserializes list-like remote values such as arrays, node lists, or HTML collections.

methods.name: deserializeBidiMapping
methods.description: Deserializes object or map remote values into JavaScript objects.
